action.mutates: on the node: creates /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 if root has none, copies its public half to /run/p8test-sync/root.pub (handed to the peer), and appends "$PEER_ADDR p8test.example.invalid" and "<the peer's address + 100> p8test2.example.invalid" to /etc/hosts

on the peer: creates the account p8testuser with the node root's public key as its only authorized key, and /srv/p8test (owned by it) with a.txt, sub/b.txt, gone.txt and big.bin (6 MiB from /dev/urandom); adds its +100 alias address to enp0s8, inserts `-I INPUT -d <alias> -p tcp --dport 22 -m comment --comment p8test-sync-port -j REJECT`, and starts an extra sshd on port 2222 (/usr/sbin/sshd -p 2222, /run/sshd created if absent)
